title: EP 7 — CLAUDE RUNS A TEAM IN PARALLEL
sub: Subagents each get their own context window and tools
lines: One Claude, working on three parts of your codebase at the same time.
One Clawd, working on three parts of your codebase, at the same time.
Meet subagents: each one gets its own context window, tools, and prompt.
Meet subagents. Each one gets its own context window, its own tools, and its own prompt.
Define one as a tiny file in .claude/agents, or just run /agents.
Define one as a tiny file in dot Clawd slash agents. Or just run slash agents.
Then say: research the auth, database, and API modules in parallel.
Then say. Research the auth, database, and A.P.I. modules, in parallel.
Claude spawns a subagent per module — they run at once, then report back.
Clawd spawns a subagent per module. They run at once, then report back.
The noisy work stays in their context, so your main chat stays clean.

Heads up: subagents can't spawn more subagents, and big results cost context.
